notes:
Lead source: inbound signup (support automation category). Product: lightweight helpdesk + automation for SMB merchants. Primary ask: embed an LLM assistant that can (1) summarize incoming tickets into short triage notes, (2) call internal tools to open/update tickets via structured JSON responses (tool-calling), and (3) return strict schema for agent UI to ingest.

Key requirements / signals:
- Latency target: median <= 300ms for summary endpoint, P95 < 700ms; peak throughput ~15-25 QPS during business hours.
- Cost sensitivity: high; want cost per ticket under $0.02 after batching/caching.
- Model preferences: open-model friendly, will evaluate gpt-style vs smaller quantized LMs for inference cost. Interested in Redwood's curated model catalog and cost/perf recommendations.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML) for admin console, audit logs for actions, NA data residency for logs & transcripts, basic KMS for API keys (optional).
- Ops: wants transparent per-route token cost and simple SDK to integrate with Node back-end.

From call: CEO Luis - "We need something we can bolt on quickly that doesn't break our margins." SE notes: Jordan asked for sample structured schema (ticket.title, ticket.priority, suggested_tags[], create_ticket: {enabled:true, payloadSchema}).

POC plan (requested):
- Provide hosted API key + 10k free tokens on staging
- Run 5000 ticket-summarization calls with tool-calling simulated (mock webhook)
- Measure latency, token usage, and validate structured JSON fidelity

Open / blockers:
- SAML setup in staging (customer IT team slow to provide IdP metadata)
- Need clear pricing on sustained 20 QPS pattern (concern re: cold starts)
- Legal asked for SOC2 summary; we have SOC2 in product collateral but want short FAQ for SMB buyers.

Suggested next actions (AE/SE):
- Send quick SAML setup guide + ask for IdP metadata (Maya)
pitch_notes: Spin: Hosted API fits bolt-on use-case; emphasize easy self-serve + predictable per-ticket economics. Highlight Optimize suggestions for batching and prefix caching to reduce unit cost. Offer staging creds & 10k token credit; propose 2-week technical POC.
